title: js-toml allows uncontrolled recursion in `load()` leading `RangeError` (stack exhaustion) on deeply nested input…
description: The js-toml library's load() function parses TOML input using recursive parsing and interpretation without enforcing a maximum nesting depth. Deeply nested arrays, inline tables, or dotted keys cause recursion to exceed the V8 JavaScript engine's call stack limit, triggering an uncaught RangeError. This error differs from the expected SyntaxParseError, breaking error handling contracts and potentially crashing Node.js processes if unhandled. The issue affects versions prior to 1.1.3 and is fixed in 1.1.3.
